hero.title: Terms of Service
hero.intro: These Terms of Service (the "Terms") govern your access to and use of the Service operated by Sole Proprietor Suleimenov Iskander Kabylbekovich (BIN 070423500888), registered in the Republic of Kazakhstan (the "Provider", "we", "us"). By creating an account or using the Service, you agree to be bound by these Terms.

sections.title: 1. Accounts
paragraphs: To use the Service you must create an account. You are responsible for keeping your credentials secure and for all activity that happens under your account.

You must be at least 18 years old, or the age of majority in your jurisdiction, to use the Service. If you create an account on behalf of a company or other legal entity, you represent that you have authority to bind that entity to these Terms.
You agree to provide accurate, complete and up-to-date information. We may suspend or terminate accounts that contain false or misleading information.

sections.title: 2. Subscriptions and billing
paragraphs: The Service is offered on tiered subscription plans (Free, Standard, Plus, Pro). Paid subscriptions are billed in advance on a recurring monthly or yearly basis, depending on the plan selected.
Payment is processed by Paddle.com Market Limited ("Paddle"), our Merchant of Record. By subscribing, you also agree to Paddle's Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.

Subscriptions automatically renew at the end of each billing period unless cancelled before the renewal date. You may cancel at any time from your organization's billing page; cancellation takes effect at the end of the current paid period.
All prices are listed in USD. Applicable taxes (VAT, GST, sales tax) are added at checkout based on your billing country and remitted by Paddle.
If a payment fails, we will retry the charge for up to 14 days. If payment remains unsuccessful, your organization will be downgraded to the Free tier.

sections.title: 3. Refunds
paragraphs: Refunds are handled according to our separate Refund Policy. In summary: a first-time subscription is eligible for a full, self-service refund within 14 calendar days of the first payment, available once per organization from your billing page. Renewals and recurring charges are non-refundable except where required by law.

sections.title: 4. Acceptable use
paragraphs: You agree not to use the Service to:
(a) violate any applicable law, regulation or third-party right;
(b) send spam, unsolicited bulk email, or messages that violate anti-spam laws (CAN-SPAM, GDPR, etc.);

(c) sell or facilitate the sale of: weapons, illegal drugs, counterfeit goods, stolen items, adult content, gambling services, pyramid schemes, multi-level marketing schemes, services that infringe intellectual property rights, or any other goods or services restricted by Paddle's Acceptable Use Policy;
(d) upload malware, phishing pages, or content designed to deceive or harm other users;
(e) attempt to gain unauthorized access to the Service, other accounts, or our infrastructure;
(f) reverse engineer, decompile, or attempt to extract source code from the Service;
(g) use automated systems (bots, scrapers) to access the Service in ways that disrupt other users.
We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate this section, with or without prior notice depending on the severity of the violation.

sections.title: 5. Your data and content
paragraphs: You retain ownership of all data you upload to the Service ("Customer Data"), including products, orders, customer records, emails, files and analytics.
You grant us a limited license to host, process, transmit and display your Customer Data solely as necessary to provide the Service to you.

You are responsible for ensuring that you have all necessary rights and consents to upload Customer Data, including consent from your end users (your storefront shoppers) where required by applicable privacy laws.
We will not sell, rent or share your Customer Data with third parties except as described in our Privacy Policy or as required by law.

Each plan includes a storage allowance for the files you upload (product images, digital files, attachments). If your organization exceeds its plan's storage limit — for example after downgrading to the Free plan — we email the organization owner once per day for 14 days. If the organization is still over the limit after that period, we may automatically delete files, oldest first, until storage is back within the limit. Re-subscribing or freeing up space before the deadline prevents any deletion.

sections.title: 6. Service availability
paragraphs: We aim to keep the Service available 24/7 with a target uptime of 99.5% per calendar month, measured at the API and CRM console.
We may perform scheduled maintenance, during which parts of the Service may be temporarily unavailable. We will give reasonable notice for any planned downtime.

We are not liable for downtime caused by events outside our reasonable control, including but not limited to: third-party service outages (Paddle, our cloud provider, DNS providers), force majeure events, or attacks on the Service.

sections.title: 7. Termination
paragraphs: You may terminate your account at any time by deleting your organization from the CRM console. Upon termination, your Customer Data will be retained for 30 calendar days, after which it is permanently deleted unless we are required to retain it by law.
We may suspend or terminate your account immediately if you violate these Terms, fail to pay outstanding charges, or use the Service in a way that creates legal risk for us or other users.
Sections 5 (Your data), 9 (Liability), 10 (Indemnification), and 11 (Governing law) survive termination.

sections.title: 8. Warranty disclaimer
paragraphs: The Service is provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any kind, whether express or implied. To the maximum extent permitted by law, we disclaim all warranties, including but not limited to merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, and non-infringement.
We do not warrant that the Service will be uninterrupted, error-free, or that any defects will be corrected. You use the Service at your own risk.

sections.title: 9. Limitation of liability
paragraphs: To the maximum extent permitted by law, our total aggregate liability arising out of or related to these Terms or the Service shall not exceed the greater of: (a) the amount you paid us in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim, or (b) one hundred US dollars (USD 100).

In no event shall we be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential or punitive damages, including but not limited to: loss of profits, loss of revenue, loss of data, loss of goodwill, or business interruption — even if we have been advised of the possibility of such damages.

sections.title: 10. Indemnification
paragraphs: You agree to indemnify and hold us harmless from any third-party claims, damages, losses, liabilities, costs and expenses (including reasonable legal fees) arising out of or related to: (a) your use of the Service in violation of these Terms; (b) your Customer Data; (c) your violation of any law or third-party right; or (d) your end users' claims against you.

sections.title: 11. Governing law and disputes
paragraphs: These Terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Republic of Kazakhstan, without regard to conflict of laws principles.

Any disputes arising out of or in connection with these Terms shall be resolved first through good-faith negotiation. If no agreement is reached within 30 calendar days, the dispute shall be submitted to the competent courts of Almaty, Republic of Kazakhstan.

sections.title: 12. Changes to these Terms
paragraphs: We may update these Terms from time to time to reflect changes in the Service, our legal obligations, or industry practice. Material changes will be communicated by email to the organization owner at least 30 calendar days before they take effect.

Continued use of the Service after the effective date constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms. If you do not agree with the updated Terms, you must stop using the Service and may request a refund of any unused subscription period.

hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Sole Proprietor Suleimenov Iskander Kabylbekovich (BIN 070423500888), registered in the Republic of Kazakhstan ("we", "us", "Provider"), collects, uses, stores and protects personal data when you use the Torta CRM service (the "Service").

sections.title: 1. Who this policy applies to
paragraphs: This policy applies to two groups of people:
(a) Merchants — the people and businesses who sign up to use Torta CRM to run their online stores.
(b) Shoppers — the end users (your customers) who interact with merchant storefronts powered by our Service.

For shoppers: your data is collected and controlled by the merchant whose store you visited. We process this data only as a service provider to that merchant. Please contact the merchant directly for data access or deletion requests.

sections.title: 2. Data we collect from merchants
paragraphs: When you create a Torta CRM account, we collect:
• Identity data — name, email address, password (hashed), profile photo (optional)
• Account data — organization name, project names, language and timezone preferences, role assignments
• Billing data — subscription plan, billing address, tax ID (where applicable). Payment card details are collected and stored by Paddle, not by us
• Usage data — pages visited in the CRM, features used, API request volume, browser type, IP address, session timestamps
• Communications — support requests, feedback, and any messages you send to us

sections.title: 3. Data we process for shoppers (as service provider)
paragraphs: When a shopper interacts with a merchant's storefront powered by the Service, we may process on the merchant's behalf:
• Identity data — name, email, phone (if provided by the shopper)
• Order data — purchases, shipping addresses, payment status
• Behaviour data — products viewed, cart contents, session duration
• Communications — chat messages, email opens and clicks

We act as a data processor for this data. The merchant is the data controller and is responsible for: their privacy notice to shoppers, lawful basis for collection, and responding to shopper rights requests.

sections.title: 4. How we use data
paragraphs: We use merchant data to:
• Provide, operate and maintain the Service
• Process subscriptions and send invoices (via Paddle)
• Send transactional emails (account verification, password reset, billing receipts, security alerts)
• Send product updates and feature announcements (you can opt out at any time)
• Analyse usage patterns to improve the Service
• Detect and prevent fraud, abuse, and security incidents
• Comply with legal obligations

sections.title: 5. Lawful basis for processing
paragraphs: We process personal data on the following lawful bases (under GDPR and similar regulations):
• Contract — to provide the Service you signed up for
• Legitimate interest — to improve the Service, detect fraud, ensure security
• Consent — for marketing emails (you can withdraw consent any time)
• Legal obligation — to comply with tax law, court orders, regulatory requests

sections.title: 6. Who we share data with
paragraphs: We share data with a small number of trusted third-party service providers, each bound by contract to protect your data:
• Paddle (Paddle.com Market Limited, UK) — payment processing, tax remittance
• Google LLC (USA) — OAuth authentication for merchants who choose to sign in with Google
• Our infrastructure provider (IONOS SE, Germany) — server hosting and email delivery
We do not sell or rent your personal data to anyone. We may disclose data if required by law, court order, or to protect our rights or the safety of others.

sections.title: 7. International transfers
paragraphs: Our infrastructure is located in the European Union (Germany, via IONOS). Some service providers (Google, Paddle) may process data outside the European Economic Area.
When data is transferred internationally, we rely on Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission, or equivalent safeguards under applicable law.

sections.title: 8. How long we keep data
paragraphs: • Account data — retained while your account is active, plus 30 days after termination
• Billing data — retained for 7 years to comply with tax law (Republic of Kazakhstan)
• Usage logs — 90 days
• Support communications — 3 years from last contact
After these periods, data is permanently deleted or anonymised.

sections.title: 9. Your rights
paragraphs: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to:
• Access — request a copy of the personal data we hold about you
• Rectification — ask us to correct inaccurate or incomplete data
• Erasure — ask us to delete your data (subject to legal retention requirements)
• Portability — receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Restriction — ask us to restrict processing of your data
• Objection — object to processing based on legitimate interest
• Withdraw consent — for any consent-based processing
To exercise any of these rights, write to {{email}}. We respond within 30 calendar days.

sections.title: 10. How we protect data
paragraphs: We use industry-standard security measures including:
• Encryption in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256)
• Hashed passwords (bcrypt with a per-user salt)
• Multi-tenant data isolation — each merchant's data is scoped by organization and project
• Role-based access control with page-level permissions
• Audit logging of administrative actions
• Regular security reviews and dependency updates
Despite these measures, no system is completely secure. If we become aware of a data breach affecting your personal data, we will notify you and the relevant authority within 72 hours.

sections.title: 11. Cookies and tracking
paragraphs: We use a minimal set of first-party cookies, all strictly necessary for the Service to function:
• Authentication cookies — to keep you logged in (httpOnly, secure)
• Preference cookies — to remember your language and theme
We do not use third-party tracking cookies or advertising cookies. We do not load Google Analytics or similar trackers on our CRM.

sections.title: 12. Children's privacy
paragraphs: The Service is not intended for children under 16. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 16. If you become aware that a child has provided us with personal data, please contact us and we will delete it.

sections.title: 13. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be communicated by email to all merchants at least 30 days before they take effect.

hero.title: Refund Policy
hero.intro: This Refund Policy explains when and how you can request a refund for Torta CRM subscriptions. Refunds are processed by our payment processor, Paddle.

sections.title: 1. Free tier
paragraphs: Our Free plan is permanently free and does not require a payment method. You can use it as long as you like without any charge — it's not a trial and does not expire.

We do not offer a free trial on paid plans (Standard, Plus, Pro). When you subscribe to a paid plan, payment is taken immediately. If the plan turns out not to fit your needs, you are protected by our 14-day money-back guarantee — see the next section.

sections.title: 2. 14-day money-back guarantee
paragraphs: For first-time paid subscriptions, we offer a full refund within 14 calendar days of the first payment if you are not satisfied with the Service, for any reason. This guarantee can be used once per organization.

You can request the refund yourself, with one click, from the billing page of your organization while you are within the 14-day window — it is processed automatically through Paddle back to your original payment method, and your organization returns to the Free plan. If you run into any trouble, you can also email {{email}}.

sections.title: 3. Renewals
paragraphs: Subscription renewals (monthly or yearly) are non-refundable. We will send a reminder email 7 days before each renewal, giving you time to cancel if you no longer wish to continue.
You can cancel your subscription at any time from the billing page in your CRM. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current paid period — you keep access to all paid features until then.
Once a renewal has been charged, the new period is non-refundable. If you cancel after a renewal, you keep access until the period ends and then drop to Free tier.

sections.title: 4. Plan downgrades
paragraphs: When you downgrade to a cheaper plan, the change takes effect at the end of your current billing period. We do not refund the difference between plans for partial periods.
When you upgrade to a more expensive plan mid-cycle, you are charged a pro-rated amount for the remaining days of the current period.

sections.title: 5. Exceptions
paragraphs: Refunds outside the 14-day window may be granted at our discretion in the following cases:
• Significant Service outages that prevent you from using the Service
• Billing errors on our part
• Cases required by applicable consumer protection law in your jurisdiction (e.g. EU statutory withdrawal rights)

Refunds will not be granted for: (a) failure to cancel before renewal; (b) unused subscription time after voluntary cancellation; (c) violations of our Terms of Service that resulted in account termination.

sections.title: 6. How refunds are processed
paragraphs: Once a refund is approved:
• Refunds are issued to the original payment method (credit card, PayPal, etc.)
• Processing time depends on your bank, typically 5-10 business days
• The refund amount is in the original transaction currency
• Paddle handles the actual refund transaction; you may receive an email from Paddle confirming the refund

sections.title: 7. Questions
paragraphs: If you have any questions about this Refund Policy or want to request a refund, write to {{email}}. We respond to all refund requests within 5 business days.
